course_name_original: Creación de Empresas de Base Tecnológica
prerequisites: It is preferable for students to have already passed the first-year compulsory subject 'Empresa', as well as several technological subjects directly linked to the subsequent exercise of their profession. The former will speed up the transmission of basic knowledge about the structure and functioning of companies. The latter aims for students to take advantage of this knowledge by contemplating it from a different and integrating perspective based on incorporating commercial value into it.

learning_outcomes.text: Integrate and give a commercial vision to knowledge from other technological subjects.
Practice interpersonal skills related to teamwork (leadership, communication, group management, negotiation...) in any professional activity.
Relate with real external agents to the University (suppliers, clients, financial entities...) and know the organizations and instruments supporting entrepreneurs.
Foster entrepreneurial spirit in any professional activity.
Put into practice business communication techniques.

syllabus_topics: Creation of companies: the business plan and technology
Generalities: objectives, methodology and work plan of the subject.
The process of creating a technological micro-enterprise: market study and business plan.
Environment to study, study approach and instruments.
Income statements (or profit and loss) and cash flow statements (or collections and payments).
teaching_methods: Teamwork (simulation of a consulting firm with manager, organizational chart, task distribution, project draft elaboration, chronograms, independent meetings, mailing lists, periodic work reports)
Contact with real external professionals (advisors to entrepreneurs)
Visits to external entities (City Business Center, Gijón Science and Technology Park)
Market research (surveys, interviews with customers, competitors, suppliers)
Obtaining information (legal procedures, subsidies, bank loans, location)
Formal weekly project presentations to professor and advisors
Workshop on job search techniques (CV writing, cover letters, personal interviews)
assessment_rules: For the ordinary assessment, the final grade is calculated as: PLAN_EMPRESA x 0.5 + EXA_FIN x 0.3 + PA x 0.2. A minimum attendance of 75% to scheduled classes is required; otherwise, the final grade will be "Not Presented". To pass the subject, the calculated final grade must be at least 5 points. For extraordinary and differentiated assessments, the final grade is calculated as: PLAN_EMPRESA_EXTRA x 0.6 + EXA_EXTRA x 0.4, with a minimum of 5 points required to pass. Students must inform the professor at least 4 weeks before the exam date to receive the project topic and submit the definitive business plan at least 48 hours before the exam.
